evals.prompt: Run a UX audit on https://news.ycombinator.com
evals.expected_output: A graded markdown report covering interaction patterns, performance perception, and accessibility with specific issues and fixes

assertions.text: Report contains Summary, Grades table, all 3 category sections, and Priority Fixes
Overall letter grade (A-F) and per-category grades are present
Numeric scores out of 100 for overall and each category
Each issue labeled Critical, Major, or Minor
Issues include specific fix recommendations
What's Working Well sections are present
References specific metrics, axe-core findings, or screenshot observations
Overall grade is C or below
